highlights: Earn up to 8 miles per dollar on travel, hotel and flight bookings though Agoda and Expedia. Enjoy up to 3 miles per dollar for overseas purchases and 1.4 miles per dollar on local spend, including dining, retail and online spend. Additionally, receive 1 mile per S$1 or UNI$2.5 per S$5 for bill payments via the UOB Payment Facility.
pros: Earn 3 miles per S$1 spend (UNI$7.5 per S$5 spend) on regional spend in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, including online shopping on overseas website.
pros: Earn 2.4 miles per S$1 spend (UNI$6 per S$5 spend) on other overseas spend, including online shopping on overseas websites.
pros: Earn 1.4 miles per S$1 spend (UNI$3.5 per S$5 spend) on local spend.
pros: 4 complimentary lounge visits annually, exclusive for Principal Cardmembers.
pros: Earn up to 8 miles per S$1 spend (UNI$20 per S$5 spend) on agoda and Expedia bookings via UOB PRVI Miles website.
pros: Earn up to 6 bonus KrisFlyer miles for every S$1 spend if you also apply for a new KrisFlyer UOB Account.
pros: Complimentary personal accident coverage and emergency medical assistance of up to S$500,000.
pros: Choice to redeem for miles, cashback, or vouchers.
pros: No minimum spend and no cap on earned miles

sign_up_offers.title: Welcome Offer
sign_up_offers.terms:
Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new-to-UOB credit card customers only.
Successfully apply to be the principal cardholder for select UOB Credit Cards within the promo period and spend a min. of S$1,000 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for 
S$100 Samsung Voucher
 reward.
Plus, receive a 10% discount when you use your UOB Credit Card on Samsung Singapore transactions via the Samsung online store with min. spend of S$1,000.
Samsung reserves the right to amend or withdraw the discount promotion without prior notice.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.

sign_up_offers.title: SingSaver Flash Deal
sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Flash Deal promotion is valid from 2 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new-to-UOB credit cardmembers only.
Be one of the first 2 applicants at 2 PM & 10PM every day during the flash deal period to apply for selected UOB credit cards and make a min. spend of S$500 within the first 30 days of card approval to be eligible for the Flash Deal reward:
S$200 Cash via PayNow
; or a
Samsonite Straren Spinner 67/24 (worth S$600)
.
Remaining applicants will receive 
S$90 Cash via PayNow
.
Promotion is stackable with UOB Welcome Offer (additional T&Cs apply).
Terms and Conditions
 apply

extra.description: The UOB PRVI Miles World Mastercard lets you earn miles at a rate of up to 3 miles per S$1 spend overseas, 1.4 miles per S$1 spend locally and up to 8 miles per S$1 spend on your hotel and airlines bookings via Agoda and Expedia through dedicated link on UOB PRVI Miles website. Plus, you can also enjoy 4 complimentary lounge visits before jetting off to your favourite destinations!
